overview: Prism Matrix is a first-person optical-themed station puzzle. The current implementation uses three discrete prism-station activations rather than a free-angle beam simulator. Visit all stations, then energize the mainframe terminal.
rules: Activate all three prism stations; order does not matter.
Each station counts once and disables after use.
Station three enables the mainframe control early, but the mainframe still requires all three aligned counters.
Interact with the mainframe after all three activations to complete the game.
controls: WASD/arrows move; mouse looks; Shift sprints; Space jumps; Ctrl crouches.
Approach and aim at an enabled control, then press E to interact.
Escape opens the native menu; F5/F9 quick-save/load in the stock client.
story: The documented setting is an optical redirection matrix. No named characters, personal backstories or narrative campaign are established.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
